scope: 30 sequential fresh timing processes; three repetitions rotate five worker/reader/placement combinations and alternate before/selected order. Source placement is checked from native epoll socket ownership at the independently verified ready gate; shared means private and broadcast sources use one worker, separate means different workers. Setup-only rejects are recorded and excluded before traffic begins; performance is never used for selection. One or four server workers on CPUs0-3, one fixed four-thread verifying client on CPUs4-7. Six measured seconds, one private pair, eight full Close/EOF reconnect workers and0/64/512 broadcast readers,1KiB values/window16. Every complete body/sender/FIFO, reader/message matrix, controlled departure, metric/byte total and resource/exit check retained. Client/server CPU separate. No builds/profiles/other loads overlap timing.
